inspectedText: Review describes depleted U235 and characteristic fission-product isotope patterns; activity about two billion years ago. Different uranium half-lives imply a larger ancient U235 share. Water moderation and neutron absorption constrain operation. RZ13 xenon measurements support a modeled intermittent operating regime. Water content, ore composition and geometry constrain but do not uniquely establish every ancient operational detail.
inspectionMethod: Actual parsed PDF body opened and relevant sections read in session web tool. Bounded original summary and exact locators retained, not raw HTTP body, underlying data or source figure-pixel inspection.

limitations: Relevant pages inspected in parsed PDF; review synthesizes original investigations, not independent raw-data replication.
